reference_answer: tree_digest currently hashes each path and file bytes for paths where is_file is true. A broken symlink has no file bytes, so changing its target text leaves the digest unchanged. Hash the symlink target as a distinct entry (and preserve path and regular file hashing) so both broken and valid symlink retargeting change the digest. The prepared test fails red with equal digests at the pinned commit.

facts: Broken symlink target changes are invisible to the current digest.
The digest is used to detect modifications to read-only exported workspaces.

ambiguities: A symlink to an existing file may be followed by is_file, but target text still needs explicit representation.

must_check: symlink target included even when broken
regular file content and path checks preserved
acceptable_alternatives: Any unambiguous byte framing for file versus symlink entries is acceptable.
do_not_penalize: Reasonable implementation details not dictated by the prompt if behavior and invariants are preserved.

decision_changing_errors: Concatenating symlink target text with followed file bytes without unambiguous framing.
